name: frontend-alb-response-time
title: Frontend responses are consistently slow
description: The frontend average response time has exceeded one second during at least seven of the last ten minutes.
investigation_steps: Review the matching logs to identify slow request paths.
Check frontend and API task health, CPU, memory and task counts.
Check for slow database queries, failed dependencies or recent deployments that might have caused this.
Check for wider infrastructure issues that might be affecting response times, including problems with AWS services.

query: fields @timestamp, service_name, upstream_response_time, request_uri, status, real_forwarded_for, @message, @logStream
